pmc.title: Fitness · fatigue · form
pmc.aria: CTL and ATL lines with TSB bars over the last 90 days
pmc.tip:
Blue CTL = fitness (42-day average load); rising = getting fitter.
Orange ATL = fatigue (7-day average); above the blue line = training more than usual lately.
Bars TSB = yesterday's CTL − ATL. Negative is not bad: heavy training makes it negative.
Bar colour by TSB ÷ CTL: red < −30% High Risk (plan recovery), green −30 to −10% Optimal, light purple −10 to +5% grey zone, purple +5 to +25% Fresh (race-ready), yellow > +25% Transition (resting too long). Rules of thumb (Friel); a direction only.
